texts.zh:
据报告，[sentinel_system.GetName]附近出现激烈的战斗。哨兵组织的母星系处于崩溃的边缘。

我们收到了一段从哨兵阿尔法——哨兵组织用作总部的军用空间站，传来的长程通讯片段。该恒星系因大量武器发射和能量残余造成了严重的信号干扰。
texts.en:
Intense fighting has been reported in the immediate vicinity of [sentinel_system.GetName]. The home system of the Sentinels is on the verge of being overrun.

We have picked up a partial long-range transmission from Sentinel Alpha, the battlestation that serves as the headquarters of the Sentinel Order. Jamming and residual energy pockets from the massive amount of weapon discharges now occurring within the system are causing heavy signal interference.
